# Ashenford Cordage - twine order scanner

The order scanner walks twine orders whose entries sometimes spread over more than one line.
The inline flags the team uses are carded in reference/flag-cards.tsv.

turns.prompt: Ashenford Cordage scans twine orders whose entries sometimes spread over more than one line. In the scanner's pattern the dot currently stands for any character except a line break. Give the inline flag fragment that goes at the front of the pattern and makes the dot stand for a line break as well. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
